games.notes: Team point totals (Ohio State 71, Purdue 60) confirmed both by the printed TEAM TOTALS row and by summing player points (which also equals 2*FG+3PT_made+FT_made per the printed TOTALS-row identity). Ohio State's 5 starters (White, Francis, Carter, Wilson, Burson) and reserve John Anderson had fully legible 16-column rows (all secondary stats -- reb/ast/pf/to/blk/stl -- included with confidence, cross-checked OR+DR=REB). Purdue's McCants, Lewis, and Scheffler rows were likewise fully legible. For the remaining bench players on both teams (Ohio State: Bradley [all-zero row, unambiguous], Scott Anderson, Mateen; Purdue: Kip Jones, Todd Mitchell, Everett Stephens, Tony Jones), the scan shows blank cells for some zero values, shifting the printed column count by one and making individual OR/DR/REB/PF/AST/TO/BLK/STL assignments unreliable to reconstruct with confidence -- those keys were omitted per 'never invent values' while FG/3PT/FT/PTS/MIN were retained because they were independently verified against the team column totals (FG, 3FG-made, 3FG-att, FT-att all summed exactly to the printed TOTALS row, and the single remaining team-wide FT-made discrepancy of 1 was resolved to Everett Stephens based on his otherwise fully consistent FT 1-1 line).
